fit_predict_cusum_detector_model: build a python module to detect multiple change points in a univariate time series using CUSUMDetectorModel with configurable scan and historical windows
fit_predict_vectorized_cusum_detector_mo: build a python module to detect multiple change points in a multivariate time series using VectorizedCUSUMDetectorModel with vectorized detection
calculate_percentage_change_score: create a function to calculate percentage change anomaly scores by dividing absolute change by baseline mean
calculate_z_score: create a function to calculate z-score anomaly scores using the formula z = (x - mu) / sigma
serialize_cusum_model: create a function to serialize a CUSUMDetectorModel to JSON bytes for persistence and later deserialization
